name: o-json: copy from the original structure

actions.label: Mark a branch in the original tree
actions.caption: space marks items, then j moves to its item shape while the mark stays. Keep a source branch marked as you explore the structure.

actions.label: Copy a source branch as a path
actions.caption: Press y then h: y copies .items, then h collapses its branch. The next key resolves y because y j and y m now copy recipes. Keep the source path ready for a new output.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
